[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Decode ways II** [LC 639 · Decode Ways II](https://leetcode.com/problems/decode-ways-ii/){difficulty="Hard"}

Every decoding of a prefix ends in a one-character letter or a two-character letter. Those two groups do not overlap. A star does not change the states: it changes the **weight** of the arrow. `*` as one letter has weight 9. The pair `2*` has weight 6 (`21`–`26`), not 9, because `27`–`29` are not letters.

[Solved in full in @sec-od-p3-decode.]{.card-link}
